// MARK: - SPECIFICATION IDENTITY: Who this specification is and what version it is. Held apart from the keys because it describes the whole document; a version stated twice is a version that can disagree with itself.
name: Iris Interoperability Specification
// MARK: - VERSION: Emitted as I2S::kVersionMajor / kVersionMinor. Every version group in spec/i2s_keys.json must be at or below this version; append-only means a bump never invalidates a file written under an earlier one.
// MARK: - REVISION HISTORY: One entry per version, oldest first, rendered into the specification document.

revisions.summary: Initial draft. Defines the key schema (name, short name, DICOM counterpart, value type, multiplicity, identity class, PHI flag), the value types and identity classes, and seeds the Digital Slide Identifier with its PHI flag DSI_is_PHI (absent means PHI) and the scanner's identity (manufacturer, model, serial number, software versions, unique device identifier); the serial number and unique device identifier are under review as possible device-level identifiers.
